z-m-33-01.title: Ngokuthi kunikwe amanqaku amathathu, inqaku elishiyekileyo li-1 kuphela?
z-m-33-01.topic: Ukufumana ikona eshiyekileyo yepharalelogram xa kunikwe iikona ezintathu
z-m-33-01.goal: Gweba ukuba ikona eshiyekileyo yepharalelogram imiselwe kwinqaku e-1 xa zizikona ezintathu kuphela ezaziwayo, uthi kutheni ingamiselwanga nokuba ngowuphi olunye ulwazi olufunekayo (ucwangciso lwamagama ekona), uze ufumane amanqaku anokwenzeka wena.
z-m-33-01.material: Kwiplani yolungelelwaniso kukho amanqaku amathathu A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(5, 4). Indlela yokuwafunda: A ngu-'zero, zero', B ngu-'ne, nye', C ngu-'ntlanu, ne'. La manqaku amathathu akalali kumgca o-1. Ufuna ukukhetha inqaku D ukuze amanqaku amane A, B, C, D abe ziikona zepharalelogram e-1. Ingxaki yokuqala ithi kuphela 'vumela ikona yesine ibe D', kwaye ayithethi ukuba iikona zidityaniswe ngocwangciso luni. Onke ulungelelwaniso lungamanani anyanisekileyo, yaye amanqaku amane ahlukile omnye komnye.
z-m-33-01.thinking.1: Ukwahlula iimeko ezinokwenzeka nokuzifumana ngaphandle kokuphosa
z-m-33-01.thinking.2: Ukuchaza indlela ulwazi olongezelelweyo lunciphisa ngayo inani leemeko
z-m-33-01.prereq.0: Ukuzoba amanqaku kwiplani yolungelelwaniso nokufunda umkhombandlela nenani lentshukumo phakathi kwamanqaku amabini
z-m-33-01.prereq.1: Iimpawu zepharalelogram (macala achaseneyo ahambelana yaye alingana ubude, iidayagonali ziyabhisekwa) - inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi
z-m-33-01.prereq.2: (Lo msebenzi ubekwe kwi-H2 ukuze kube lula ukuvelisa; unika inqanaba lobunzima, hayi ukubekwa kwibanga. Kucingelwa ukuba ufundiswa emva 'kolungelelwaniso lweplani' kwiMathematika eNtsonkothileyo.)
z-m-33-01.s.s1.prompt: Ingaba indawo yenqaku D imiselwe ngolwazi olungentla? Khetha ugwebo olufanelekileyo kakhulu.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba u-A, B, no-C kwiplani yolungelelwaniso wongeze inqaku e-1 ngaphezu kula manqaku mathathu ukwenza ipharalelogram.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tshintsha ukuba leliphi kula manqaku mathathu liphambene ne-D, zoba i-D ixesha ngalinye, uze uhlole ngamehlo ixesha ngalinye ukuba macala achaseneyo ahambelana na.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.a: Imiselwe kwinqaku e-1. Amanqaku amathathu amiselwe, ngoko elokugqibela li-1 nalo
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba xa amanqaku amathathu emiselwe, eseleyo imiselwe kwinqaku e-1. Khumbula ukuba igama le-quadrilateral (ABCD) linocwangciso olwakhelwe ngaphakathi.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.b: Ayimiselwanga. Macala kufuneka ahambelane kuphela, ngoko zikho ezingapheliyo
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.b: Kubonakala ukuba ufunde umqathango wokuhambelana njengesibini e-1 kuphela. Ipharalelogram inamacala amabini ahambelana, yaye imiqathango emibini engakumbi imisela inqaku. Zoba amanqaku wena ukuhlola.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.o.c: Ayimiselwanga. Ixhomekeke ekubeni linye inqaku liphambene nalo naliphi
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.c: Ubonise ukuba i-D iyatshintsha xa isibini esiphambeneyo sitshintsha. Ukuba ubala nokuba zingaphi izibini ezinokwenzeka, uya kubona inani.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.r.d: Ubone ukuba zikho ii-D ezininzi, kodwa kubonakala ukuba ubale ezinye kuphela. Phumela kuyo yonke inqaku elinokuphambana ne-D, elinye ngexesha.
z-m-33-01.s.s1.explain: Ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni leliphi kuma-A, B, C liphambene ne-D, ipharalelogram iyatshintsha, ngoko zikho iindawo ezintathu ezinokwenzeka ze-D. Ukuba unikwa ulwazi lokuba amagama eekona adityaniswa ngocwangciso (umzekelo, quadrilateral ABCD), izibini eziphambeneyo zimiselwe yaye i-D inciphela kwi-1. Ngoko ulwazi olongezelelweyo olufunekayo kule ngxaki lucwangciso lweekona.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.prompt: Fumana uze ufake amanqaku ama-3 ahlukeneyo D(x, y) ahlangabezana nomqathango. Kwanele ukuba amanqaku amane abe ziikona zepharalelogram e-1 ngocwangciso oluthile. Kwibhokisi engezantsi, kuqala bhala kuphela ulungelelwaniso lwamanqaku, uze emva koko ubhale izizathu.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha elinye lamanqaku amathathu uthi 'liphambene ne-D', uze ujonge ukuba i-D inxulumene njani necandelo elidibanisa amanqaku amabini asele.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tshintsha inqaku olikhethayo njengelo liphambeneyo ngocwangciso A, B, C, uze uthelekise ukuba ii-D eziphumayo ziyahluka omnye komnye na.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Le yindawo apho u-A, B, C, D baba ziikona zepharalelogram e-1.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ngeli nqaku D, ukudibanisa u-A, B, C, D ngawo nawuphi na ucwangciso akwenzi pharalelogram. Hlola ukuba iindawo ezimbindini zamanqaku amabini aphambeneyo ziyafana na.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.explain: Ii-D ezinokwenzeka ziingaphi amanqaku amathathu (9, 5), (1, 3), (-1, -3). Ziimeko apho i-D iphambene no-A, B, no-C ngokwahlukeneyo, yaye kwimeko nganye iindawo ezimbindini zamanqaku amabini aphambeneyo ziseindawo enye.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala ukuba kutheni i-D ingamiselwanga kwinqaku e-1, nokuba ucinga ntoni ngokuba kunokubakho ii-D ezininzi ezinokwenzeka.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Phawula ukuba lilipi kuma-A, B, C inqaku ngalinye owalizobileyo liphambene nalo.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala ukuba zingaphi amanqaku anokuphambana ne-D.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ndichaze ukuba kutheni i-D itshintsha njenge'leliphi inqaku liphambene nalo'?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndibhale, nokuba ngumgca o-1, isizathu se'ingaba kunokubakho ezinye' (ubungqina bokuba ndihlule zonke iimeko)?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ndakhetha inqaku e-1 endalizobayo ndaphinda ndahlola ukuba macala alo achaseneyo ahambelana na?
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.model.0: I-D itshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni ithatha amanqaku amabini athini njengeekona eziphambeneyo. Ukuba iphambene no-A yi-(9, 5), ukuba iphambene no-B yi-(1, 3), yaye ukuba iphambene no-C yi-(-1, -3). Zi-A, B, C kuphela ezinokuphambana ne-D, ngoko ama-3 ayo yonke.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Iindawo ezimbindini zeedayagonali kufuneka zifane, ngoko ukukhetha elinye lamanqaku amathathu njengelo liphambene ne-D kunika i-D e-1 nganye. Zikho iindlela ezi-3 zokukhetha, ngoko i-D inendawo ezi-3, yaye ndicinga ukuba akunakubakho ezinye.
z-m-33-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Nokuba awuzange ubhale ulungelelwaniso, kwanele ukuba unalo inani nesizathu.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.prompt: Ulwazi olutsha lufikile. Xa uphinda wahlola ingxaki, yathi 'ipharalelogram ABCD', yaye iikona zidityaniswe ngocwangciso A, B, C, D (A no-C ziphambene, B no-D ziphambene). I-D ikuphi ngoku?
z-m-33-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ziikona ezithini ezikufutshane ne-D kwi-ABCD.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha inqaku uze uhlole wena ukuba intshukumo ukusuka kwicala AB ukuya kwicala DC ineomkhombandlela ofanayo nobukhulu obufanayo.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.a: Ufunde ngathi u-A no-D baphambene. Kucwangciso ABCD, izibini eziphambeneyo ngu-A no-C, no-B no-D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.b: Ulibeke ukuze u-B no-D baphambane. Hlola ukuba macala achaseneyo AB no-DC aneomkhombandlela nobude obufanayo.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.c: Ufunde ngathi u-C no-D baphambene. Kucwangciso ABCD, abamelwane buka-C ngu-B no-D.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.r.d: Waphosisa ukuba ucwangciso lumisela izibini eziphambeneyo. Ukuba ucwangciso lunikwe, bhala ukuba liphi inqaku liphambene no-A nelo liphambene no-B.
z-m-33-01.s.s3.explain: Kucwangciso ABCD, u-B no-D baphambene, ngoko D = A + C - B, oko kukuthi, (0+5-4, 0+4-1) = (1, 3). Hlola: vector AB = (4, 1), kwaye vector DC = (5-1, 4-3) = (4, 1), eyafanayo. Ulwazi olutsha lwancitshiswa lwaya kwenye yeendawo ezintathu ezinokwenzeka.

z-m-33-02.title: Ukuba kuphuma umgca, izangqa ezi-2 ziyadibana?
z-m-33-02.topic: Indawo yezangqa ezi-2 nomgca ovela kulingano lwezangqa ezi-2
z-m-33-02.goal: Sebenzisa imizekelo ukuhlola ukuba nokuba umgca uhlala uphuma kulingano lwezangqa ezi-2, oko kuphela akuthethi ukuba izangqa ziyadibana, uze wakhe izangqa ezi-2 ezingadibaniyo wena ukuthi yintoni enye efuneka ukuhlolwa.
z-m-33-02.material: Ulingano lwesangqa C1 yi-x²+y²=4 (iziko (0, 0), irediyasi 2). Indlela yokuyifunda: 'x isikwere kudibanisa y isikwere kulingana ne-4'. Isangqa C2 sineziko (d, 0) nerediyasi r, ngo-d>0, r>0. Ulingano lwaso yi-(x-d)²+y²=r². UHayun wasusa ulingano lwe-C2 kulingano lwe-C1 macala ngamacala wafumana ibinzana lomgangatho wokuqala ku-x, wathi, 'Kuphume umgca, ngoko izangqa ezi-2 ziyadibana kumanqaku amabini adlula kuwo lo mgca.' Apha, izangqa ezi-2 'ziyadibana' kuthetha ukuba likho inqaku elilala kuzo zombini izangqa (kuquka imeko yokuchukumisana).

z-m-33-02.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yolingano lwesangqa (x-a)²+(y-b)²=r² nokufunda iziko nerediyasi
z-m-33-02.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yeendawo zezangqa ezi-2 (zahlukene, zichukumisana, zidibana kumanqaku amabini, esinye siqulathe esinye)
z-m-33-02.prereq.2: (Lo msebenzi ubekwe kwi-H2 ukuze kube lula ukuvelisa; unika inqanaba lobunzima, hayi ukubekwa kwibanga. Kucingelwa ukuba uza emva kokufunda ulingano lwesangqa kwiMathematika eNtsonkothileyo.)
z-m-33-02.s.s1.prompt: Idatha iya kutyhilwa inye ngexesha. Ixesha ngalinye, gweba ukuba izangqa ezi-2 zidibana kumanqaku amangaphi, uze ucinge ukuba ungayithemba kangakanani intetho kaHayun.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ulungelelwaniso lwenqaku elilala emgceni ngqo kulingano lwe-C1 ukuhlola ukuba lunelisa ngenene nalo.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.1: Xa d no-r zitshintsha, thelekisa umgama phakathi kwamaziko amabini nesixa sezirediyasi.

z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ungathi 'izangqa ezi-2 ziyadibana' ngenxa yokuba kuphume umgca kuphela?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Umgca ophumayo lulwazi lokuba 'ukuba kukho amanqaku okudibana, alala kulo mgca'. Isiqinisekiso sokuba kukho amanqaku okudibana kufuneka sihlolwe ngokwahlukeneyo. Masivavanye ngedatha elandelayo.

z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ukuba awuwazi amaxabiso ka-d no-r, lo mgca akuxeleli nto

z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Imisiwe ukuba d = 6, r = 1. Ukususa ulingano kunika 12x = 39, oko kukuthi, umgca x = 13/4 = 3.25. Ukuze inqaku elilala kulo mgca lilale ne-C1, udinga y² = 4 - (13/4)² = -105/16 (y inyanisekile).

Oku kuhambelana nenyaniso yokuba umgama we-6 phakathi kwamaziko mkhulu kunesixa serediyasi, esingu-3, ngoko izangqa zahlukene. Kuphume umgca, kodwa izangqa ezi-2 azidibani. z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Inqaku e-1. Umgca ne-C1 badibana kwinqaku e-1

z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ugwebe ngokusekelwe kwisiphumo sokulinganisa amanqaku asemgceni nolingano lwe-C1.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Utshintshele ku-d = 3, r = 2. Ukususa ulingano kunika 6x = 9, oko kukuthi, umgca x = 3/2. Ukuyifaka kwi-C1 kunika y² = 4 - 9/4 = 7/4.
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngeli xesha, izangqa ezi-2 zidibana kumanqaku amangaphi?
z-m-33-02.s.s1.st.2.after: y = ±√7/2 (malunga nama-±1.32), ngoko zidibana kumanqaku amabini (3/2, ±√7/2). Isebenza nakwicala le-C2: (3/2 - 3)² + 7/4 = 4. Kule meko isigqibo sikaHayun sasilungile. z-m-33-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imizekelo apho intetho kaHayun iphosakele wena. Khetha iziko (d, 0) nerediyasi r ye-C2 uze ufake iindidi ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo zeemeko apho izangqa ezi-2 zingadibani. Vumela umzekelo o-1 ube yiwo apho izangqa ezi-2 zahlukene ngaphandle komnye nomnye, kwaye omnye yiwo apho isangqa e-1 siqulathe esinye ukuze zingadibani.

z-m-33-02.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo: (d, r) = (5, 1) unomgama phakathi kweziphakamisi o-5, omkhulu kunesixa serediyasi 3, ngoko zahlukene ngaphandle, kwaye (1, 5) iC2 iqulathe iC1, ngoko azidibani (irediyasi ye-C1 yi-2, kwaye umgama wesiphakamisi 1 mncinci kunomahluko wesiphakamisi ezimbini, 3). Kuzo zombini iimeko d > 0, ngoko kuphuma umgca, kodwa izangqa ezimbini aziyidibani. Imeko yokuchukumisa ngaphakathi (umzekelo, d = 2, r = 4) idibana kwinqaku elinye, ngoko ayibalwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.prompt: Xelela uHayun: xa ususa iinkcazelo kuphuma umgca, kufuneka kuhlolwe ntoni enye phambi kokuthi 'izangqa ezimbini ziyadibana,' kwaye kutheni? Bhala.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala bhala kumgca omnye ukuba kutheni, kumzekelo d = 6, r = 1, bangadibananga nangona kuphume umgca.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.1: Khumbula ngaluphi ukubala okanye ukuthelekisa owafunda ngalo kuloo mzekelo ukuba azidibani.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndihlukanise, ngamazwi am, ukuba inyaniso yokuba kuphume umgca nenyaniso yokuba izangqa ezimbini ziyadibana ayiyonto enye?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ukuba ndisebenzisa indlela yokuhlola endiyibhalileyo kumzekelo d = 6, r = 1, ingaba inika isigqibo sokuba azidibani?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ndithe nini amanqaku adlula kuwo umgca alele kuzo zombini izangqa?
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.0: Nokuba kuphuma umgca, kufuneka uhlole ngokwahlukileyo ukuba likho na inqaku eliqhelekileyo lezangqa ezimbini kuloo mgca. Faka umgca kwinkcazelo yesangqa esinye ubone ukuba kuphuma inqaku lokudibana lokwenyani, kwaye ukuba hayi, izangqa ezimbini aziyidibani.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.1: Ungathelekisa nomgama phakathi kweziphakamisi nesixa okanye umahluko werediyasi. Umgca uhlala uphuma ngaphandle kokuba d yi-0, ngoko ukuba nomgca nje akuqinisekisi amanqaku okudibana, kwaye kufuneka uhlole ukuba zikho ngokwenene iindawo zokudibana.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Zombini indlela yokufaka kumgca nendlela yokuthelekisa imigama iyamkelwa.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.model.2: Kufuneka uthelekise umgama d phakathi kweziphakamisi zezangqa ezimbini nesixa serediyasi 2+r nomahluko |2-r|. Ukuba ukhulu kunesixa okanye mncinci kunomahluko, izangqa ezimbini aziyidibani nokuba kuphuma umgca.
z-m-33-02.s.s3.modelNote.2: Impendulo esebenzisa ukuthelekisa umgama iyamkelwa nayo.
